assigned_test_proof.diagnosis: Hub message timestamps of the failed run (evidence/failed-run-agent-f6899445.json.gz): Lisbon explore's single web_fetch of https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/regions ran 11:08:28 to 11:15:02Z (394s, 'Activity timed out after 180.0s', 'Time Elapsed 6m 33s') while sibling fetches took 2-9s; root then needed 109s to synthesize and the 549s cap hit. Cause: Firecrawl 120s + Parallel Extract 120s (240s) and sequential 30s-per-phase downloads exceed the 180s activity timeout and loop/activity_helper.py retries a timeout (2 attempts). Which of the two activities timed out is not observable (cloud guest logs not retained); both are bounded.
